diagnosis: SignedContractSitemap publishes download URLs for confidential CustomerNDAContract instances in a sitemap. Search engine crawlers, competitors, and unauthenticated attackers can scrape the XML sitemap at /sitemaps/contracts.xml to enumerate contract primary keys and harvest executed agreements containing proprietary terms.
exploit_request:
GET /sitemaps/contracts.xml HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.contractvault.com
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)
Accept: application/xml
